title: Air Pressure Lab
objectives: Link air pressure to suckers and syringes

stages.title: The Weight of Air
stages.narration: The Baron scoffs that 'air is nothing'. Show him the ocean of air has real power!

steps.text: A sealed can suddenly crumples on the bench.
Newton Bot: 'Prove the Baron wrong, Air Ace.'

stages.title: Air Pressure — Up or Down?
stages.prompt: Sort each statement about atmospheric pressure as true or false.

cards.label: Pressure is lower up a mountain
Air pressure increases as you go higher
Air pressure can never crush a can

stages.note: Air is matter with weight, so it presses on everything — and less air higher up means lower pressure.

stages.title: Atmospheric Pressure at Work
stages.prompt: Tap each device to see air pressure in action. Visit them all!

locations.label: Rubber Sucker
locations.info: Air is squeezed out; higher outside pressure holds it to the wall.

locations.label: Syringe
locations.info: Pulling the plunger lets air pressure push liquid inside.

locations.label: Straw
locations.info: Reduced pressure inside lets air push your drink up.

locations.label: Barometer
locations.info: Measures air pressure; a sudden drop can warn of a storm.

stages.title: Mini-Boss: Harness the Air
stages.prompt: Score 80% to use air pressure and claim shard 6!

questions.explain: The weight of the air above presses down on us.

questions.q: Higher up a mountain, air pressure…
questions.explain: Less air above means lower pressure.

options: outside air pressure pushes it to the wall
questions.explain: Removing inside air lets outside pressure hold it.
Air flows from high-pressure to low-pressure regions.
Like liquid pressure, air presses in every direction.

stages.title: Momentum Shard 6 Charged!
messages: 🏅 You earned the Air Ace badge
The 'powerless' air just powered your win!
